inputs.text: I run a small bakery in Indiranagar. I just want a one page website with our menu, opening hours, photos, a map, and a WhatsApp button to order. Nothing fancy. Maybe later a way to pre-order cakes.

assumptions: Single or small number of admin users; no role-based access control required at launch
Client will provide final content (exact bakery name, WhatsApp number, menu, logo, photos) unless they pay for copy/photography
Google Maps is preferred by default but OpenStreetMap can be used if client requests or no API key is provided
Hosting will be the client's choice; agency will provide deployment guidance and one-time assistance to enable HTTPS
Pre-order, payment and SMS integrations are Phase 2 / optional and not required for initial delivery
Basic analytics (GA4) will be configured under the client's analytics account if they supply it; otherwise agency can configure under its account temporarily

drivers: Single-page public site is simple and low-UI complexity
Requires a small backend (auth, content storage, image upload + optimization)
Admin UI and media handling add moderate implementation and testing effort
Optional features (pre-orders, payments, SMS/WhatsApp Business) would raise complexity later

comments.author: client
comments.body: Please keep the colours warm, like the shop.
